description: This file defines the NewsletterSubController class within the Goteo project, specifically managing administrative actions related to newsletters, including listing, activating, canceling, and initializing newsletter campaigns.

classes.name: NewsletterSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing newsletter-related administrative actions such as listing, activating, canceling, and initializing newsletters within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access newsletter functions based on node role.

methods.name: detailAction
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific newsletter, including recipients list and mailing details.

methods.name: activateAction
methods.description: Activates a newsletter for immediate sending and logs the action.

methods.name: initAction
methods.description: Creates a new mass mailing based on a template, assigning recipients, and preparing it for sending.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists existing newsletters and templates for administrative overview.
